title: Snake (example)
description: A small local HTML5 Snake game included with the site.
longDescription: This is a simple single-player Snake game implemented in HTML/CSS/JS. Because it is local, it will always run on your site and is a good example of adding unblocked games.

title: Zombie Baseball
description: Hit zombies with baseballs to score points — a tiny HTML5 demo.
longDescription: Zombie Baseball is a simple single-player HTML5 canvas game: click to throw baseballs from the bat to hit approaching zombies. Press R to reset. This demo is intentionally small so it runs reliably as a local game.
